# Kobana Magic Dashboard plugin

**🇺🇸 English** · [🇧🇷 Português](README.pt-BR.md) · [🇪🇸 Español](README.es.md)

The official Kobana plugin for Magic Dashboard: portal users, team and organization. It connects your AI agent to Kobana's remote MCP server and adds a skill with the product's workflows and safety rules.

## Install

In Claude Code:

```text
/plugin marketplace add universokobana/kobana-agent-marketplace
/plugin install kobana-dashboards@kobana-agent-marketplace
```

For other clients, see the [install guides](../../install/README.md).

## MCP servers

| Server | URL |
|---|---|
| `kobana-dashboards` | `https://mcp.dashboards.kobana.com.br` |

Authentication is OAuth 2.1: on first use, your client opens the Kobana login.

[Learn more about the product](https://www.kobana.com.br/en/products/magic-dashboard) · [MCP docs](https://docs.dashboards.kobana.com.br/pt/mcp/overview/introduction) · [Privacy](https://www.kobana.com.br/en/privacy)
